name: @femi9/core
description: Shared backend for both brands: services, auth, payments, pricing.
comment: This package declares what it IMPORTS, not what its first consumer happened to have installed. Until the Lumi9 image was built, only `jose` was listed here and everything else resolved out of femi9-web's hoisted tree - invisible at the workspace root, where one `npm install` satisfies everyone. `npm ci --workspace lumi9-web` installs only that workspace's closure, and the build died on @aws-sdk/client-dynamodb and maxmind. `next` and `react` are peers so a host app's copy is always the one used; two Reacts in one tree is a class of bug worth never introducing. @sentry/nextjs is an OPTIONAL peer: only femi9-web ships it, logger.ts imports it dynamically, and making it a hard dependency put Sentry's require-in-the-middle instrumentation into every image - where Turbopack externalised it under a generated name the standalone bundle could not resolve, and every route answered 500.
